name: Joovy Universal Car Seat Adapter
seatBrandsSupported: Universal (strap/click-in) — fits most infant car seats; the Clek Liing is confirmed Liing-compatible on Clek's official stroller list for these Joovy models.

priceSources.retailer: Joovy (DTC) — Zoom / Zoom 360 Universal Car Seat Adapter (SKU 9151)
Joovy (DTC) — Caboose RS Universal Car Seat Adapter (SKU 9125)

install.pieces: single click-in adapter (mounts to front of stroller)
install.notes: Click your infant seat into the adapter, no unbuckling required. The Big Caboose triple ships with two universal adapters included.

notes: Clek lists a generic 'Universal Car Seat Adapter' (no printed part number) for the Joovy Balloon, Big Caboose, Caboose, Caboose UL and Zoom 360. In Joovy's current catalog this is sold as model-specific 'Universal' SKUs — e.g. Zoom/Zoom 360 (SKU 9151, $49.90) and Caboose RS front (SKU 9125, $39.90); the Big Caboose includes two. partNumber left null because there is no single Clek-listed SKU and Joovy prints none on the classic adapter. Clek Liing compatibility confirmed by Clek's own list; Joovy's per-adapter pages render seat-fit as an image rather than text.
